焦炭烧成 CO₂、再被还原成 CO（吸热可逆）: Coke burns to CO₂, which is then reduced to CO (endothermic, reversible)

矿石颗粒（逐级剥氧）: Ore particle (oxygen stripped step by step)
渣层浮在铁水上: Slag layer floats on molten iron
矿槽、焦槽、熔剂槽 → 称量 → 斜桥 → 炉顶: Ore, coke and flux bins → weighing → skip incline → furnace top
炉喉—炉缸五带，风口、铁口、渣口: Five zones from throat to hearth, with tuyeres, taphole and slag notch
蓄热式热风炉 → 冷风变 1100–1250 ℃ 热风: Regenerative hot-blast stoves → cold air becomes 1100–1250 ℃ hot blast
铁口出铁、渣口出渣，渣铁分开走: Iron out of the taphole, slag out of the slag notch, kept apart
炉顶煤气除尘净化，CO 利用率就是成绩单: Furnace-top gas is cleaned of dust; the CO utilization rate is the report card
一堆矿石从炉顶倒下去，为什么出来就是铁水？: Ore is tipped in at the furnace top. Why does molten iron come out?
拖动视角，从左到右看一遍这座高炉：上料、本体、热风、渣铁、煤气: Drag the view and look over this blast furnace from left to right: charging, body, hot blast, slag and iron, top gas
参考工况 1200 ℃、石灰石 180 kg/t、富氧 3 %：焦比 350 k: Reference conditions 1200 ℃, limestone 180 kg/t, oxygen enrichment 3 %: coke rate 350 kg/t, hot metal output 10000 t/d, CO utilization 50.0 %; the burden column moves down while the gas moves up.
高温 · 焦炭供热并生成 CO（这是简化总式）: High temperature · coke supplies heat and makes CO (this is a simplified overall equation)
全厂五个工段：上料 → 高炉本体 → 热风 → 渣铁 → 煤气净化，料和气在本体: Five plant sections: charging → furnace body → hot blast → slag and iron → gas cleaning; charge and gas run against each other inside the body.
顶栏的 Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂ 是简化总式，真实过程还: Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂ in the top bar is a simplified overall equation; the real process also involves stepwise reduction, slag formation and carburization.
逆流是关键：煤气一路往上被消耗、被换热，才形成上部低温、下部高温的温度梯度。: Counterflow is the key: the gas is consumed and exchanges heat all the way up, creating a gradient that is cool at the top and hot at the bottom.
去掉上料与逆流：炉料不动、煤气没有通道，整座炉立刻停。: Remove charging and counterflow: the burden stops, the gas has no path, and the furnace shuts down at once.
这是一台逆流的还原炉：炉料从上往下、热风从下往上，两边对着跑，才有「上部低温、下: This is a counterflow reduction furnace: charge travels top to bottom and hot blast bottom to top, running against each other, which gives stepwise reduction from a cool top to a hot bottom.
矿石、焦炭、石灰石为什么不能混成一堆，要一层一层地铺？: Why can't ore, coke and limestone be mixed in one heap, but must be laid down layer by layer?
转到炉顶，看料批一层层落到料柱上: Turn to the furnace top and watch each batch fall onto the burden column in layers
一批料落下：焦炭层与矿层交替铺开，焦炭层是煤气往上穿的通道；本步只看布料，读数不: A batch drops: coke layers alternate with ore layers, and the coke layers are channels for gas to rise through; this step is only about charging, so the readings do not change (coke rate 350 kg/t).
矿批 / 焦批 / 熔剂批 交替入炉: Ore batch / coke batch / flux batch charged in turn
料柱必须透气 · 焦炭兼作料柱骨架: The burden must be permeable · coke also acts as the column's skeleton
石灰石随矿批入炉: Limestone goes in with the ore batch
上料按「批」：矿批、焦批、熔剂批交替入炉，形成料层。: Charging is by "batch": ore, coke and flux batches go in turn, forming layers.
焦炭要强度高、块度合适、硫磷灰分低，否则被压碎就堵死料柱。: Coke must be strong, well sized and low in sulfur, phosphorus and ash; crushed coke chokes the burden column.
石灰石随矿批加进去，进炉后才分解成 CaO——在上料阶段它还不干活。: Limestone goes in with the ore and decomposes to CaO only inside the furnace; at the charging stage it does no work yet.
去掉分层布料：料柱堵死、煤气穿不动，只能休风。: Without layered charging the burden chokes, gas cannot pass, and the blast must be stopped.
常考「焦炭为什么要强度高、块度合适」：它同时是骨架，碎料会把透气通道堵死。: A common question: why coke must be strong and well sized. It is also the skeleton, and fines would block the gas channels.
分层不是为了好看：焦炭层是料柱的骨架兼透气窗，矿层夹在中间被上升的煤气一层层还原: Layering is not for looks: coke layers are the column's skeleton and gas windows, while ore layers sandwiched between are reduced layer by layer by the rising gas; mixed in a heap, the gas cannot get through.
同一个炉子里，为什么从上到下不是一处一色？: Why does the same furnace look different from top to bottom?
炉子已经剖开，拖动视角从上往下看这五带: The furnace is cut open; drag the view and look down through the five zones
剖开后自上而下：炉喉 200–700 ℃、炉身 700–1000 ℃（约 850: From top to bottom: throat 200–700 ℃; stack 700–1000 ℃ (Fe₃O₄ → FeO around 850 ℃, limestone begins to decompose at 800–1000 ℃); belly with the cohesive zone at about 1100–1400 ℃; bosh dripping zone; tuyere raceway 1500–1600 ℃; hearth with slag and iron in layers.
温度自炉顶向炉缸递增（软熔带、滴落带边界为示意）: Temperature rises from the top toward the hearth (cohesive and dripping zone boundaries are illustrative)
块状带占了大半个炉身，是间接还原的主战场。: The lumpy zone fills most of the stack and is the main arena for indirect reduction.
软熔带（约 1100–1400 ℃）是炉料软化到熔化、初渣形成的区间，它的位置决: The cohesive zone (about 1100–1400 ℃) is where the burden softens and melts and the first slag forms; its position decides how permeable the burden is. Limestone has already decomposed to CaO above it, at 800–1000 ℃.
风口回旋带 1500–1600 ℃、理论燃烧温度 2000–2300 ℃，是全炉: The tuyere raceway at 1500–1600 ℃, with a theoretical flame temperature of 2000–2300 ℃, is the furnace's only heat source.
去掉「看进去」：学生只背得出「高温还原」，不知道温度是连续变的。: Without looking inside, students can only recite "reduction at high temperature" without knowing the temperature changes continuously.
常考「高炉内温度为什么从上到下升高」：逆流换热 + 风口燃烧供热，不是一炉子均匀: A common question: why the furnace gets hotter from top to bottom. Counterflow heat exchange plus heat from combustion at the tuyeres, not a uniformly hot furnace.
五带不是画上去的：温度自炉顶向炉缸递增，每一带只做一件事，所以铁的还原也只能一级: The five zones are not just drawn on: temperature rises from top to hearth, each zone does one job, so iron can only be reduced one stage at a time.
焦炭在风口烧出来的是 CO 还是 CO₂？: Does coke burning at the tuyeres give CO or CO₂?
对着剖开面看 5 秒：炉缸上沿那一排就是风口，剖开面里的亮团就是回旋区在燃烧: Look at the cut face for 5 s: the row along the top of the hearth is the tuyeres, and the bright blobs in the cut face are the raceways burning
风口前 1500–1600 ℃、理论燃烧温度 2000–2300 ℃；剖开面里炉: 1500–1600 ℃ in front of the tuyeres, theoretical flame temperature 2000–2300 ℃; the bright blobs along the top of the hearth in the cut face are raceways (the other tuyeres are hidden by the furnace). The textbook describes two steps: coke first burns at the tuyeres to CO₂ (exothermic), and the CO₂ rising through hot coke is reduced to CO (endothermic).
C(焦炭) + O₂(空气) =高温 CO₂（放热）→ C(焦炭) + CO₂: C(coke) + O₂(air) =high temp= CO₂ (exothermic) → C(coke) + CO₂ =high temp= 2CO (endothermic)
教材两步口径 · 风口前 1500–1600 ℃、理论燃烧温度 2000–230: Textbook's two-step account · 1500–1600 ℃ in front of the tuyeres, theoretical flame temperature 2000–2300 ℃; with excess carbon the net result equals 2C + O₂ → 2CO
再被焦炭还原成 CO: Then reduced to CO by coke
C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO 自下而上: C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO from the bottom up
教材的口径是两步：焦炭在风口先燃烧生成 CO₂（放热），CO₂ 上升穿过炽热的焦: The textbook gives two steps: coke first burns at the tuyeres to CO₂ (exothermic), then the CO₂ rising through hot coke is reduced to CO (endothermic).
这两步合起来，碳过量时的总结果相当于 2C + O₂ → 2CO——但不要因此把: Together, with excess carbon, the net result equals 2C + O₂ → 2CO, but that does not make the textbook's C + O₂ → CO₂ wrong.
教材原文还写明：C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO 是一个可逆反应，并且自下而上发生在有: The textbook also states that C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO is reversible and happens from the bottom up wherever there is coke; this is why the top gas always contains unused CO (the next section, "the puzzle of the top gas").
去掉这一步：没有 CO、没有热源，还原与熔化都不发生。: Skip this step: no CO and no heat source, so neither reduction nor melting happens.
常考「高炉里的 CO 是怎么来的」：教材要答两步——焦炭燃烧生成 CO₂（放热）: A common question: where does the CO in a blast furnace come from? The textbook answer has two steps: coke burns to CO₂ (exothermic), and CO₂ reacts with coke to give CO (endothermic, reversible); depending on the question you may also say that with excess carbon the net result equals 2C + O₂ → 2CO.
CO 不是一步烧出来的：焦炭先在风口烧成 CO₂（放热），CO₂ 上升穿过炽热焦: CO is not made in one step: coke first burns to CO₂ at the tuyeres (exothermic), and the CO₂ rising through hot coke is reduced to CO (endothermic, reversible); the tuyeres are the furnace's only heat source and the origin of its CO.
A2.2、A2.6、A3、A7-E1（人教必修2 p.48）: A2.2, A2.6, A3, A7-E1 (PEP Compulsory Book 2 p.48)
CO 一路上升，凭什么把铁从氧化物里一层层剥出来？: As CO rises, how does it strip iron out of its oxides layer by layer?
看炉内那三圈带标：CO 从下往上走，氧化物从高价往低价走: Look at the three ring labels inside the furnace: CO moves upward while the oxides move from higher to lower oxidation states
三级还原各有自己的温度：Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄ 在 200–700 ℃、Fe: Each reduction stage has its own temperature: Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄ at 200–700 ℃, Fe₃O₄ → FeO at about 850 ℃, FeO → Fe completed at about 1200 ℃.
Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄ → FeO → Fe；C(s) + CO₂(g) ⇌: Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄ → FeO → Fe; C(s) + CO₂(g) ⇌ 2CO(g) (endothermic)
条件：约 1000 ℃ 以上的高温区: Condition: the high-temperature zone above about 1000 ℃
三级还原各有自己的温度：200–700 ℃ → 约 850 ℃ → 约 1200: Each reduction stage has its own temperature: 200–700 ℃ → about 850 ℃ → about 1200 ℃.
高温区靠 C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO 把 CO₂ 换回 CO，这是吸热反应，升温: In the hot zone, C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO turns CO₂ back into CO; this is endothermic, so higher temperature favors CO, linking to reversible reactions in Elective 1 (don't write it backward as 2CO ⇌ CO₂ + C, which is the exothermic direction).
直接还原与间接还原并存：焦炭既是燃料、又是还原剂、还是料柱骨架。: Direct and indirect reduction coexist: coke is fuel, reducing agent and burden skeleton all at once.
去掉逐级还原：学生只会写总式，解释不了炉内为什么分带、焦比为什么这么高。: Skip stepwise reduction and students can only write the overall equation, unable to explain why the furnace has zones or why the coke rate is so high.
常考「C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO 是吸热还是放热、升温往哪移」：吸热，升温向生成: A common question: is C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO endothermic or exothermic, and which way does heating shift it? Endothermic; heating shifts it toward CO.
逐级还原：每一级在各自的温度带完成；温度够高的地方再由 C + CO₂ ⇌ 2C: Stepwise reduction: each stage is completed in its own temperature zone; where it is hot enough, C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO replenishes CO (endothermic and reversible, linking neatly to equilibrium).
矿石里的 SiO₂ 是杂质，凭什么能被赶出去？: SiO₂ in the ore is an impurity. How can it be driven out?
把「石灰石」切到旁路，看碱度和渣量怎么变: Switch "limestone" to bypass and see how basicity and slag volume change
碱度从 1.150 掉到 0.279（不是 0：矿石脉石与焦炭灰分自带约 30: Basicity falls from 1.150 to 0.279 (not 0: ore gangue and coke ash bring about 30 kg/t of CaO), slag 330 → 240 kg/t, coke rate 350 → 332 kg/t (coke saved, but the slag becomes viscous and cannot remove sulfur); add it back and basicity returns to 1.150.
造渣是两步：CaCO₃ 先分解成 CaO（吸热），CaO 再与 SiO₂ 成 C: Slag forms in two steps: CaCO₃ first decomposes to CaO (endothermic), then CaO combines with SiO₂ to form liquid CaSiO₃ slag; don't write it as one step.
碱度 R = CaO/SiO₂，窗口 1.0–1.3，对应滑块上 150–210: Basicity R = CaO/SiO₂ with a window of 1.0–1.3, matching the 150–210 kg/t band on the slider; turning off limestone does not mean "no slag" but "slag not basic enough".
渣浮在铁水上、从渣口排；铁水从位置更低的铁口出——方向别弄反。: Slag floats on the iron and leaves through the slag notch; iron leaves through the lower taphole. Don't get the directions backward.
去掉石灰石：渣排不出去、硫进铁，铁水又脏又脆。: Without limestone the slag cannot drain and sulfur goes into the iron, making it dirty and brittle.
常考「加石灰石的作用」：不是提供 CO₂，是分解出 CaO 造渣除 SiO₂。: A common question: why add limestone? Not to supply CO₂, but to decompose into CaO that forms slag and removes SiO₂.
CaCO₃ 先分解出 CaO（吸热），CaO 再拉走 SiO₂ 变成 CaSiO: CaCO₃ first decomposes to CaO (endothermic), then CaO carries SiO₂ away as liquid CaSiO₃ slag floating on the iron: only fluid slag gives clean iron. Skipping limestone saves coke but leaves the impurities in.
把风温调高一点，真的能省下焦炭吗？: Raise the blast temperature a little. Does it really save coke?
把热风温度从 1200 拖到 1100 ℃，看焦比和产量: Drag the hot blast temperature from 1200 to 1100 ℃ and watch the coke rate and output
风温 1200 → 1100 ℃：焦比 350 → 370 kg/t（+20）、: Blast 1200 → 1100 ℃: coke rate 350 → 370 kg/t (+20), hot metal output 10000 → 9459 t/d, CO utilization 50.0 % → 48.0 %, slag still 330 kg/t.
课件设定：风温系数 0.20 kg/(t·℃)，即每降 100 ℃ 焦比约多 2: Lesson setting: blast temperature coefficient 0.20 kg/(t·℃), i.e. about 20 kg/t more coke per 100 ℃ drop
风温经「带进显热」直接替换烧掉的焦炭，是本课最便宜的一招。: Blast heat directly replaces burned coke through "sensible heat brought in"; it is the cheapest trick in this lesson.
焦比降了，单位时间的出铁量也跟着升（本课按 产量 ∝ 1/焦比 建模，属课件设定: As the coke rate falls, iron output per unit time rises (this lesson models output ∝ 1/coke rate, a lesson setting, not a textbook law).
风温不是越高越好：越 1300 ℃ 风口与围管烧穿，低于 950 ℃ 炉缸热量不: Hotter is not always better: above 1300 ℃ tuyeres and the bustle pipe burn through; below 950 ℃ the hearth lacks heat and the furnace chills.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「多烧焦炭就行」，看不到风温这条免费的账。: Skip this step and students think "just burn more coke", missing this free account from blast temperature.
常考「提高风温为什么能降焦比」：风口带入显热替代了焦炭燃烧供热；但受热风炉与风口: A common question: why does raising blast temperature lower the coke rate? Sensible heat brought in at the tuyeres replaces heat from burning coke, limited by the life of the stoves and tuyeres.
风温每降 100 ℃，焦比大约多 20 kg/t、产量跟着掉——反过来说提高风温: Each 100 ℃ drop in blast temperature adds about 20 kg/t of coke and output falls; put the other way, raising blast temperature is the most direct way to save coke, at the cost of what the stove checker bricks and tuyeres can withstand (industrial band 1100–1250 ℃).
焦比、碱度、产量同时卡住时，你先动哪一个？: When coke rate, basicity and output are all stuck, which do you move first?
把焦比压到 ≤ 360 kg/t、碱度 1.00–1.30、产量 ≥ 10000: Push the coke rate to ≤ 360 kg/t, basicity to 1.00–1.30 and output to ≥ 10000 t/d, and hold for 15 s
进入 5 s 后夜班把风温降了两档（焦比升到 366 kg/t、产量 9563: 5 s in, the night shift lowers the blast temperature two notches (coke rate up to 366 kg/t, output 9563 t/d); you must pull it back yourself; when on target the goal bar turns green.
保持 15 s · 参考解 1250 / 180 / 4 → 336 kg/t、: Hold 15 s · reference solution 1250 / 180 / 4 → 336 kg/t, 1.150, 51.4 %, 10938 t/d
越界走事故: Out of range leads to an accident
焦比 ≤ 360 kg/t 把风温压到 ≥ 1150 ℃ 左右，产量缺口靠富氧补: Coke rate ≤ 360 kg/t pushes the blast temperature to about ≥ 1150 ℃; any output shortfall is made up with oxygen enrichment.
碱度窗口把石灰石锁在 150–210 kg/t，取多了渣量大、焦比反升。: The basicity window locks limestone to 150–210 kg/t; too much gives a lot of slag and the coke rate rises again.
风温 < 950 ℃ 走「3 s 倒计时 → 炉凉冻结」，> 1300 ℃ 走「: Below 950 ℃ leads to "3 s countdown → hearth freezes", above 1300 ℃ to "tuyere burn-through"; understand both accident chains.
去掉考核：学生只会背「提高风温降低焦比」，不会在多约束里取舍。: Without the check, students only recite "raise blast temperature to lower coke rate", unable to trade off under several constraints.
常考「为什么不取最低焦比点」：风温受设备上限约束，焦比压到极限要靠富氧与炉料质量: A common question: why not take the lowest coke rate point? Blast temperature is capped by the equipment; pushing coke rate to the limit needs oxygen enrichment and better burden, so industry uses a compromise band of 1100–1250 ℃.
焦比 ≤ 360 kg/t 把风温压到 ≥ 1150 ℃ 左右，碱度窗口把石灰石: Coke rate ≤ 360 kg/t pushes the blast temperature to about ≥ 1150 ℃, the basicity window locks limestone to 150–210 kg/t, and output still needs oxygen enrichment; the feasible region is a small patch at 1150–1250 ℃, so the compromise is calculated.
焦比 / 产量 — 热风温度: Coke rate / output vs. hot blast temperature

本班目标：焦比 ≤ 360 kg/t、碱度 1.00–1.30、产量 ≥ 100: Class goal: coke rate ≤ 360 kg/t, basicity 1.00–1.30, output ≥ 10000 t/d, CO utilization ≥ 47 %, blast ≤ 1250 ℃, held for 15 s
风温掉太低 → 炉缸热量不足 → 炉缸冻结: Blast too cold → hearth short of heat → hearth freezes
A. 为了省焦，把热风温度一路往下调: A. To save coke, the hot blast temperature is turned down and down
风口带入的显热变少，只能多烧焦炭补，焦比往上飙（410 kg/t）。: Less sensible heat comes in at the tuyeres, so more coke must burn to make up, and the coke rate soars (410 kg/t).
B. 热量还是不够，炉缸温度往下掉: B. Still not enough heat; the hearth temperature drops
渣的黏度上升、滴落不畅，风口前开始发暗。: Slag viscosity rises, dripping slows, and the tuyere fronts start to dim.
C. 渣铁黏在炉缸里排不出来: C. Slag and iron stick in the hearth and cannot be tapped
炉缸冻结，风口烧不动，只能休风处理。: The hearth freezes, the tuyeres cannot burn, and the blast must be stopped.
D. 现实做法是把风温与焦比守住底线: D. In practice, blast temperature and coke rate are held at their minimums
用富氧、喷煤调剂，不让炉凉发生。: Oxygen enrichment and coal injection are used to adjust, so the furnace never chills.
风温按热风炉能力守住下限（工业带 1100–1250 ℃）: Hold blast temperature above a floor set by stove capacity (industrial band 1100–1250 ℃)
焦比设底线，用富氧与喷煤调剂: Set a floor for coke rate; adjust with oxygen enrichment and coal injection
看风口亮度与渣温判断炉温趋势: Judge the furnace temperature trend from tuyere brightness and slag temperature
出现炉凉先减风、加焦，别硬拉: If the furnace chills, first reduce blast and add coke; don't force it
记住这条链：风温低 → 焦比高 → 炉缸热量不足 → 渣铁黏 → 冻结。省下的焦: Remember the chain: cold blast → high coke rate → hearth short of heat → sticky slag and iron → freezing. The coke you saved has to be paid back with a stoppage.
风温越界 → 风口与围管过热 → 风口烧穿: Blast too hot → tuyeres and bustle pipe overheat → tuyere burns through
A. 为提高风温把热风炉烧到上限以上: A. Stoves are fired past their limit to raise blast temperature
风温确实更高、焦比更低（330 kg/t）。: Blast temperature is indeed higher and coke rate lower (330 kg/t).
B. 越过 1300 ℃，风口与热风围管超过承受温度: B. Above 1300 ℃, tuyeres and the hot-blast bustle pipe exceed what they can withstand
铜质水冷风口与耐材的极限被压过去。: The limits of the water-cooled copper tuyeres and refractories are exceeded.
C. 风口烧穿，高温煤气从破口外窜: C. A tuyere burns through and hot gas jets out of the breach
风台与出铁场直接受威胁。: The tuyere platform and cast house are directly threatened.
D. 现实做法是按格子砖与风口寿命定风温上限，并设联锁: D. In practice the upper blast limit is set by checker brick and tuyere life, with an interlock
本演示预设了联锁失效这一条最坏路径。: This demo assumes the worst path, where the interlock fails.
风温按热风炉格子砖与风口寿命定上限: Cap blast temperature by stove checker brick and tuyere life
风口水温差与热流在线监测，超限报警: Monitor tuyere water temperature difference and heat flux online, with alarms
风温联锁：越限自动切回安全值: Blast temperature interlock: switch back to a safe value automatically when exceeded
定期检查风口小套与大套: Inspect tuyere noses and coolers regularly
风温这条账的上限不是算出来的，是设备给出的：越 1300 ℃ 就要用烧风口来交学: The upper limit of the blast temperature account is not calculated but set by the equipment: go past 1300 ℃ and you pay with burned tuyeres.
本课目标：搞清风口怎么造 CO、铁氧化物怎么逐级还原、石灰石为什么要加，最后在焦: Lesson goal: understand how tuyeres make CO, how iron oxides are reduced step by step and why limestone is added, then keep the furnace stable for 15 s within the coke rate and basicity windows.
④ 风口烧焦: ④ Burning coke at the tuyeres
按教材口径，高炉里的 CO 是怎么来的: According to the textbook, where does the CO in a blast furnace come from?
焦炭在风口一步烧成 CO: Coke burns to CO in one step at the tuyeres
焦炭先在风口燃烧生成 CO₂（放热），CO₂ 再被焦炭还原成 CO（吸热、可逆）: Coke first burns at the tuyeres to CO₂ (exothermic), then CO₂ is reduced to CO by coke (endothermic, reversible)
由铁矿石与水蒸气反应产生: From iron ore reacting with steam
人教必修2 p.48 的原句是：C(焦炭) + O₂(空气) = CO₂（放出热: PEP Compulsory Book 2 p.48 reads: C(coke) + O₂(air) = CO₂ (releases heat), C(coke) + CO₂ = 2CO (absorbs heat), and explains that C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO is reversible and happens from the bottom up wherever there is coke. With excess carbon the net result equals 2C + O₂ → 2CO, but that is only the sum of the two steps.
焦炭先在风口与高温区变成 CO，由 CO 去逐级夺氧：Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄: Coke first becomes CO at the tuyeres and in the hot zone, and CO strips oxygen step by step: Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄ → FeO → Fe. Coke's direct roles are supplying heat, supplying the reductant and acting as the skeleton.
加石灰石的作用是: Limestone is added in order to
分解出 CaO，与 SiO₂ 成渣把杂质带走: Decompose into CaO, which forms slag with SiO₂ and carries the impurities away
增加铁水含碳量: Raise the carbon content of the iron
CaCO₃ 先分解成 CaO（吸热），CaO 再与酸性杂质 SiO₂ 生成 Ca: CaCO₃ first decomposes to CaO (endothermic), then CaO forms liquid CaSiO₃ slag with the acidic impurity SiO₂, which floats on the iron and leaves through the slag notch.
把石灰石整条旁路以后，炉渣碱度: With limestone fully bypassed, slag basicity
掉到约 0.28，渣变黏: Falls to about 0.28 and the slag becomes viscous
矿石脉石与焦炭灰分本身带来约 30 kg/t 的 CaO，所以碱度不会到 0，而: Ore gangue and coke ash bring about 30 kg/t of CaO, so basicity does not reach 0 but falls to 0.279: the slag is not basic enough, becomes viscous and cannot remove sulfur.
铁氧化物逐级还原的正确顺序是: The correct order of stepwise reduction of iron oxides is
按含氧量从高到低：Fe₂O₃（200–700 ℃）→ Fe₃O₄（约 850 ℃: From highest to lowest oxygen content: Fe₂O₃ (200–700 ℃) → Fe₃O₄ (about 850 ℃) → FeO (completed at about 1200 ℃) → Fe.
提高热风温度能降焦比，原因是: Raising hot blast temperature lowers the coke rate because
风温让矿石更容易熔化: Hot blast makes ore melt more easily
风口带入的显热替代了焦炭燃烧供热: Sensible heat brought in at the tuyeres replaces heat from burning coke
风温提高了 CO 利用率却没代价: Hot blast raises CO utilization at no cost
风温增加了煤气量: Hot blast increases the gas volume
单位铁需要的热量由「焦炭燃烧 + 热风显热」共同提供；风温越高，显热带进来的越多: The heat each tonne of iron needs comes from "burning coke + sensible heat of the blast"; the hotter the blast, the more heat it brings and the less coke must burn. The cost is what the stoves and tuyeres can withstand.
焦炭层的骨架保证料柱透气，煤气才穿得上去: The coke-layer skeleton keeps the burden permeable so the gas can rise through
让炉料熔化更快: To make the burden melt faster
煤气要从下往上穿过整根料柱；焦炭层是透气窗与骨架。混成一堆或焦炭被压碎，料柱就堵: Gas must rise through the entire burden column; coke layers are its windows and skeleton. Mixed in a heap, or with crushed coke, the column chokes and the blast must stop.
为什么工业高炉把风温控制在 1100–1250 ℃，而不是一路拉高: Why do industrial blast furnaces keep blast temperature at 1100–1250 ℃ instead of raising it all the way?
风温越高焦比越高: Higher blast temperature raises the coke rate
热风炉格子砖与风口寿命给出了上限，越 1300 ℃ 会烧风口: Stove checker bricks and tuyere life set an upper limit; above 1300 ℃ tuyeres burn
风温与焦比无关: Blast temperature has nothing to do with coke rate
在设备能力范围内，风温越高焦比越低；但超过热风炉与风口的承受温度就会烧穿风口。所: Within the equipment's capacity, hotter blast means a lower coke rate, but beyond what the stoves and tuyeres withstand the tuyeres burn through. So it is a compromise band set by equipment limits, not a calculated optimum.
